purpose: Cuatro muestras ilustrativas de los paquetes de Sistemas y Soporte TI, ajustadas al servicio descrito.

specs.title: Optimización, Limpieza y Mantenimiento de Software Remoto
specs.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE wide 2400 x 1000 landscape photographic cover for the specific IT service below. The service activity must be immediately understandable; four different service covers, not a generic computer-parts background. A believable ordinary IT workspace photographed in soft daylight, realistic practical equipment, normal optical detail, natural wear and physically correct cables and reflections. Keep the meaningful subject in the middle horizontal band for a 12:5 service card.
No added headlines, badges, captions or explanatory labels outside the photographed scene. Short interface text requested below belongs ONLY inside the actual photographed monitor screen. No decorative network lines, floating icons, huge padlocks or shields, neon, glowing circuits, blue light washes, futuristic holograms, 3D rendering, fake depth layers, impossible hardware, dramatic cinematic lighting, logos or watermarks. No recognizable people, faces, hands, headsets or telephone-call scenes. Never show a disassembled PC for a software-only remote service. No actual personal data, company names, email addresses or phone numbers.
Show the actual SOFTWARE optimization task: a close practical photograph of an ordinary unbranded dark laptop on a modest desk, screen large and readable, keyboard bottom edge visible. On screen a believable plain desktop system-management window with tabs "Procesos", "Inicio", "Rendimiento"; a simple conventional CPU/memory usage view and a short startup-program list with some entries "Deshabilitado". A small ordinary remote-session toolbar at the top makes clear this is remote computer maintenance, not hardware repair. A useful working software view, no promotional words or decorative charts. Screen nearly front-facing with a slight realistic camera angle, neutral room background softly out of focus. No loose chips, brushes, opened case or piles of wires.
